title: Conventional Branch specification document
description: The structure of spec.json, the machine-readable form of the Conventional Branch specification. This schema describes the document itself, not the branch names it defines — for those, use grammar.regex. Version 1 of this schema is stable: it will only ever gain optional properties.

spec.description: The name of the specification this document describes.

version.description: The semantic version of the specification. A copy of this document is served permanently at https://conventionalbranch.org/v<version>/spec.json.

license.description: The SPDX identifier of the license the specification is published under.

separator.description: The character that joins the type to the description.

trunkBranches.description: Long-lived branches that are exempt from the naming convention.

types.description: Every branch type the specification defines.

type.description: The canonical prefix, used before the separator.

aliases.description: Accepted short forms of the type. May be empty.

category.description: Why the type exists: what the work is (purpose), or which agent produced it (ai-source).

description.description: What the type is for, in one line.

rules.description: Constraints on the description part of a branch name, in prose and as data. grammar.regex is the authoritative form.

descriptionAllowedCharacters.description: Character classes permitted in the description, as regex fragments.

notes.description: Prose that explains the rules and their edge cases.

grammar.description: The branch name grammar, in two equivalent forms.

abnf.description: The grammar as ABNF (RFC 5234), for readers and parser generators.

regex.description: The authoritative validator: an anchored regular expression that accepts exactly the branch names this specification allows. Written in a dialect every major regex engine understands.
